Cards in order: ["Personal","Organization","Provider","Answer style","Matter and Contract conversion prompts","Contract analysis prompts"]; aria-expanded {"Provider":"false","Answer style":"false","Matter and Contract conversion prompts":"false","Contract analysis prompts":"false"}. The Provider header chip reads "Not connected". No Request conversion card. Answer style opened on its own: radios ["Few word summary","1-2 sentence summary","Full clause text"], all 3 disabled, "1-2 sentence summary" checked, and the card says "Connect an AI provider to choose an answer style."

steps.action: Choose the provider configuration: Provider list, per-preset controls (Deployment endpoint, Protocol and Base URL, Ollama without Base URL or key), Azure manual model entry

steps.actual: Provider lists ["Anthropic","OpenAI","Azure OpenAI","Gemini","OpenRouter","Groq","Ollama","Custom endpoint"]. Per preset: Azure OpenAI: endpoint label "Deployment endpoint", Protocol null, Load models 0, Enter model ID manually 0, Model plain text box prefilled "gpt-5.6-luna", key required true; Custom endpoint: endpoint label "Base URL", Protocol ["Anthropic Messages","OpenAI-compatible chat completions","Gemini"], Load models 1, Enter model ID manually 1, Model combobox prefilled "", key required true; Ollama: endpoint label null, Protocol null, Load models 1, Enter model ID manually 1, Model combobox prefilled "llama3.2", key required false; Groq: endpoint label null, Protocol null, Load models 1, Enter model ID manually 1, Model combobox prefilled "openai/gpt-oss-120b", key required true; OpenRouter: endpoint label null, Protocol null, Load models 1, Enter model ID manually 1, Model combobox prefilled "~openai/gpt-latest", key required true.

steps.action: Output token limit: slider and exact input, default 32,768, range 1,024 to 262,144, warning below 32,768
steps.expected: The slider and the exact input show 32768; min 1024, max 262144; typing 16384 shows the warning; 32768 removes it.
steps.actual: "Output token limit per API call" slider min 1024, max 262144, value 32768; exact input 32768. At 16384 the warning read "Below 32,768 tokens, analyses are more likely to fail with incomplete responses, especially with reasoning models. This is a guideline; the tokens needed vary by model and document."; at 32768 it was gone. Nothing was saved.
